submission.justification: Crystal-K3 at 6 cm thickness provides the best energy resolution at 662 keV with 2.772% FWHM, representing a 38.4% improvement over Crystal-K1 and a 67.4% improvement over Crystal-K2. The simulation systematically evaluated all three crystal candidates across the allowed thickness range (2-10 cm), with initial testing at 2, 5, and 10 cm. Fine-tuning around the optimal region identified 6 cm as the best thickness for K3, yielding a 4.4% resolution improvement over the 5 cm baseline. This configuration delivers superior energy resolution critical for the low-background assay programme of construction materials for the dark-matter experiment, while meeting all low-background operational requirements.
